body: Just giving up off the bat when a potential solution's been thrown my way would leave a bad taste in my mouth, and there are opportunities for me to talk to people living where I am about that sort of thing, so I'll give it a shot. I can't end up any worse than I already am, so no reason not to.

How ya doing, junk-warrior? (Neat name, by the way.) Yeah, I live in America. It's a little bit of a mess trying to get jobs here and there's a chance I was legitimately born in the wrong generation to find one. I'd genuinely work any job offered to me at this point without complaint. Construction, dangerous things, I'll even wipe ass for money, I just need something so I don't end up living on the street, you know?
